observed.waves: fine wind ripples and cat's paws, no whitecaps, no swell; smooth patches near the board
observed.wind: very windy offshore (west) at the outer edge ~100 m out, gusty; light in the lee of the revetment where the photo was taken
observed.notes: Exiting Diversey Harbor at the mouth, looking south along the Fullerton revetment to the skyline. Water clarity: pale green-turquoise and translucent near the board, clear to slightly cloudy (roughly 1-3 FNU by eye); Sentinel-2 (Oct 26, newest clear view) had 2.0 FNU at Diversey. The paddlers hugged the shoreline because of the wind farther out; the water stayed calm (offshore wind, no fetch). Buoy 45174 ~7 m/s WSW, crib ~9-10 m/s W, Oak St 1-2 m/s at the time.

verdict_note: sea state: forecast rougher; wind: forecast offshore 16 mph gusting 24 was borne out ~100 m out, so the no-go (offshore drift) was consistent with what the paddlers met
